_comment: Document types the drafting assistant can create. Read by backend/app/documents.py (AI prompt + validation) and frontend/src/lib/documents/loadLibrary.ts (rendering). Field keys are camelCase and unique per document; `parties` are the two signing roles; `standardTerms` is a template from catalog.json.

documents.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
documents.description: Both parties share confidential information (e.g. to evaluate a deal or partnership) and must protect each other's information.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.hint: How Confidential Information may be used
fields.default: Evaluating whether to enter into a business relationship with the other party.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.hint: When the MNDA starts

fields.label: MNDA Term
fields.hint: The length of this MNDA, e.g. expires after N years or continues until terminated

fields.label: Term of Confidentiality
fields.hint: How long Confidential Information is protected, e.g. N years (trade secrets protected while they remain trade secrets) or in perpetuity
fields.default: 1 year from Effective Date, but in the case of trade secrets until Confidential Information is no longer considered a trade secret under applicable laws.

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.hint: US state whose law governs, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Jurisdiction
fields.hint: Courts for disputes, e.g. courts located in New Castle, DE

fields.label: MNDA Modifications
fields.hint: Changes to the Standard Terms, or None

documents.name: Cloud Service Agreement
documents.description: A provider sells a cloud/SaaS product to a customer on a subscription.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.hint: When the agreement starts

fields.label: Order Date
fields.hint: Date of the Order Form

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.hint: Length of the subscription, e.g. 12 months from the Order Date

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.hint: Deadline to give notice of non-renewal, e.g. 30 days before the end of the Subscription Period

fields.label: Technical Support
fields.hint: Support the Provider gives, e.g. email support on business days

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.hint: Liability cap, e.g. fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.hint: Claims the Provider indemnifies, e.g. IP infringement by the Cloud Service

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.hint: Claims the Customer indemnifies, e.g. claims arising from Customer Content

fields.label: DPA
fields.hint: Data Processing Agreement that applies, or None

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.hint: US state whose law governs, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.hint: Courts for disputes, e.g. state or federal courts in New Castle, DE

documents.name: Service Level Agreement
documents.description: Uptime and support response-time commitments, with service credits, added to a cloud service subscription.

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.hint: Subscription the SLA applies to, e.g. 12 months from the Order Date

fields.label: Target Uptime
fields.hint: Monthly availability target, e.g. 99.9%

fields.label: Uptime Credit
fields.hint: Credit if uptime is missed, e.g. 10% of monthly fees

fields.label: Scheduled Downtime
fields.hint: Maintenance windows excluded from uptime, e.g. Sundays 1-3am UTC with 48 hours' notice

fields.label: Target Response Time
fields.hint: Support response target, e.g. 4 business hours

fields.label: Response Time Credit
fields.hint: Credit if response time is missed, e.g. 5% of monthly fees

fields.label: Support Channel
fields.hint: How to request support, e.g. support@provider.com

documents.name: Data Processing Agreement
documents.description: How a provider processes a customer's personal data (GDPR-style processor terms), alongside a main agreement.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.hint: The main agreement this DPA supplements, e.g. Cloud Service Agreement dated January 1, 2027

fields.label: Nature and Purpose of Processing
fields.hint: Why and how personal data is processed

fields.label: Duration of Processing
fields.hint: e.g. the term of the Agreement

fields.label: Categories of Personal Data
fields.hint: e.g. names, email addresses, usage data

fields.label: Categories of Data Subjects
fields.hint: e.g. Customer's employees and end users

fields.label: Special Category Data
fields.hint: Sensitive data processed (health, biometrics...), or None

fields.label: Special Category Data Restrictions or Safeguards
fields.hint: Extra safeguards for special category data, or None

fields.label: Frequency of Transfer
fields.hint: e.g. continuous

fields.label: Approved Subprocessors
fields.hint: Subprocessors the Customer approves, e.g. a list or a URL

fields.label: Provider Security Contact
fields.hint: Email for security matters

fields.label: Security Policy
fields.hint: Provider's security policy, e.g. a URL

fields.label: Governing Member State
fields.hint: EU member state for the Standard Contractual Clauses, e.g. Ireland

documents.name: Design Partner Agreement
documents.description: An early customer (design partner) gets access to a product in development and gives feedback.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.hint: When the agreement starts

fields.label: Program
fields.hint: The design partner program: product access and what the Partner does

fields.label: Term
fields.hint: Length of the program, e.g. 6 months from the Effective Date

fields.label: Fees
fields.hint: Fees the Partner pays, or None

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.hint: US state whose law governs, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.hint: Courts for disputes, e.g. state or federal courts in New Castle, DE

documents.name: Professional Services Agreement
documents.description: A provider performs services (consulting, implementation, development) and delivers work product under a Statement of Work.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.hint: When the agreement starts

fields.label: Deliverables
fields.hint: Work product the Provider delivers under the SOW

fields.label: SOW Term
fields.hint: How long the SOW lasts, e.g. until the Deliverables are accepted

fields.label: Fees

fields.label: Payment Period

fields.label: Customer Obligations
fields.hint: What the Customer must provide, e.g. access to systems

fields.label: Rejection Period
fields.hint: Time to reject a Deliverable, e.g. 10 business days

fields.label: Resubmission Period
fields.hint: Time to fix a rejected Deliverable, e.g. 10 business days

fields.label: Time of Assignment
fields.hint: When Deliverable IP transfers, e.g. upon payment in full

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.hint: Liability cap, e.g. fees paid under the SOW

fields.label: Increased Cap Amount
fields.hint: Higher cap for Increased Claims, or None

fields.label: Increased Claims
fields.hint: Claims subject to the Increased Cap, or None

fields.label: Unlimited Claims
fields.hint: Claims with no liability cap, or None

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.hint: Claims the Provider indemnifies

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.hint: Claims the Customer indemnifies

fields.label: Additional Warranties
fields.hint: Extra warranties, or None

fields.label: Customer Policies
fields.hint: Customer policies the Provider must follow, or None

fields.label: Insurance Minimums
fields.hint: Required insurance coverage, or None

fields.label: Security Policy
fields.hint: Security policy that applies, or None

fields.label: DPA
fields.hint: Data Processing Agreement that applies, or None

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.hint: US state whose law governs, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.hint: Courts for disputes, e.g. state or federal courts in New Castle, DE

documents.name: Business Associate Agreement
documents.description: HIPAA terms for a provider (business associate) that handles protected health information for a covered entity.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.hint: The main agreement this BAA supplements, e.g. Cloud Service Agreement dated January 1, 2027

fields.label: BAA Effective Date
fields.hint: When the BAA starts

fields.label: Breach Notification Period
fields.hint: Time to report a breach, e.g. 5 business days after discovery

fields.label: Limitations
fields.hint: Limits on use or disclosure of PHI, or None

fields.label: Payment Process

fields.label: Deletion Procedure

documents.name: AI Addendum
documents.description: Adds terms for AI features of a product: inputs, outputs and limits on training with customer data.

fields.label: Training Data
fields.hint: Customer data the Provider may use for training, or None

fields.label: Training Purposes
fields.hint: What training is allowed for, e.g. improving the AI Services

fields.label: Training Restrictions
fields.hint: Limits on training, e.g. no training on Customer Input

fields.label: Improvement Restrictions
fields.hint: Limits on using Customer data to improve the Product, or None
